title: CEO to discuss commercialization, key milestones, and potential catalysts in fireside chat with WTR
summary: October 22 investor event will explore eXoZymes’ commercialization, manufacturing economics, path to market launch, growth strategy, and milestones ahead. Los Angeles, CA -- October 21, 2026 -- Today, eXoZymes Inc. (NASDAQ: EXOZ) (“eXoZymes”) - a pioneer of AI-enhanced enzymes that transform abundant feedstock into valuable nutraceuticals and novel medicines - announced that Chief Executive Officer, Michael Heltzen, will participate in a fireside chat hosted by Water Tower Research (“WTR”) tomorrow, Thursday, October 22, 2026, at 11AM Eastern / 8AM Pacific Time.
body_markdown:
- [October 22 investor event](https://video.exozymes.com/secret/133520626/90d0409958e436ce1af65674b7c0db86) will explore eXoZymes’ commercialization, manufacturing economics, path to market launch, growth strategy, and milestones ahead.


**Los Angeles, CA -- October 21, 2026 -- Today, eXoZymes Inc. (NASDAQ: EXOZ) (“eXoZymes”) - a pioneer of AI-enhanced enzymes that transform abundant feedstock into valuable nutraceuticals and novel medicines - announced that Chief Executive Officer, Michael Heltzen, will participate in a fireside chat hosted by Water Tower Research (“WTR”) tomorrow, Thursday, October 22, 2026, at 11AM Eastern / 8AM Pacific Time.**
